donors.head: 69b33b3b80084e04f63323e7d4518117f1f71048
donors.observation: one owner's campaign commanders were collected into Set<Card> commanders = new HashSet<>() inside GameImpl.checkStateBasedActions and asked once per card while iterating that set. CardImpl does not override hashCode and commander ids are random UUIDs, so the order of the 'move to the command zone?' questions varied from JVM to JVM whenever one owner had two commanders and both died in the same state-based-action check. The answers and the resulting game were unchanged; only the order of the questions differed, and twin replay of an otherwise identical game therefore produced two different semantic transcripts.
donors.fix: LinkedHashSet plus Comparator.comparing(Card::getName) on the exile stream: one owner's commanders are asked in graveyard order, then exiled commanders in name order. Ordering only; no Rules outcome changes.
